rounds.text: Global Education Ltd exhibits significant fundamental deceleration and severe working capital distress that undermine its recent price performance. Compounded profit growth has stalled dramatically, registering a meagre 3% over three years [E20] and contracting by 2% over the trailing twelve months [E21]. This profit stagnation coincides with a sharp compression in operating margins, which dropped 18 percentage points to 38% in March 2026 compared to three years prior [E29], alongside an inconsistent yearly margin trend [E31]. Furthermore, cash generation is severely compromised by high debtors stretching to 171 days [E62], resulting in a cash conversion ratio of just 0.56x where reported profits far outpace actual operating cash flow [E33]. Valuation multiples also appear stretched relative to peers, with an EV/EBITDA of 11.78x exceeding the sector benchmark of 9.1x [E11], while institutional money flow registers negative as institutional holdings decline [E43, E68]. These fundamental weaknesses drive extreme volatility of 59.8% [E53] and a terrifying historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -85.3% [E52]. Conceded: the company maintains a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.00x [E37], displays strong multi-year compounded sales growth [E14, E15], and commands high return on capital metrics [E10, E12].
